routes.citation: Tomcala, J. (2020). New Fast ApEn and SampEn Entropy Algorithms Implementation and Their Application to Supercomputer Power Consumption. Entropy 22(8), 863.
routes.bounded_read: The complete open-access article was read end to end, including abstract, Sections 1-5, appendices, references, and figure captions. Equation 2 defines original SampEn; Appendix B fixes m=2, lag=1, and r=0.2*sd as package defaults.
routes.claim_boundary: Supports SampEn as a deterministic time-series complexity descriptor and the exact template-count ratio. It does not establish a WTI trading edge, a sixty-return window, a 2.5 gate, monthly continuation, CFD equivalence, activity, profitability, or portfolio fit.

routes.bounded_read: The complete SampEn_R function and documentation were read. The implementation uses lag one, maximum-coordinate template distance, strict distance < r, excludes self-matches, defaults to m=2 and r=0.2*sample-sd, and returns log(m-match-count/(m+1)-match-count).
routes.claim_boundary: Pins executable arithmetic only. The EA independently reimplements the bounded formula and does not import or execute R or third-party code at runtime.

routes.citation: Richman, J. S. and Moorman, J. R. (2000). Physiological time-series analysis using approximate entropy and sample entropy. American Journal of Physiology-Heart and Circulatory Physiology 278(6), H2039-H2049.
routes.claim_boundary: Original-method provenance and abstract-level comparison with approximate entropy only; the publisher denied automated full-body retrieval, so the body is not represented as completely read.
